claims: Cassandra Kulukundis won the inaugural Best Casting Oscar at the 2026 Academy Awards for her work on Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another.
Cassandra Kulukundis was awarded for creating the ensemble for One Battle After Another.
Cassandra Kulukundis defeated nominees for Sinners and Hamnet in the Best Casting category.
The Best Casting category was introduced for the 98th Academy Awards to honor excellence in assembling film casts.
Cassandra Kulukundis was the 2026 Best Casting winner for One Battle After Another.
Francine Maisler was a 2026 Best Casting nominee for Sinners.
Nina Gold was a 2026 Best Casting nominee for Hamnet.
Jennifer Venditti was a 2026 Best Casting nominee for Marty Supreme.
Gabriel Domingues was a 2026 Best Casting nominee for The Secret Agent
